blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Cases of influenza-like illnesses (ILI) nationwide increased by 31 percent over two weeks, according to the Department of Health (DOH). The DOH recorded 15,042 cases from Oct. 1 to Oct. 14, up from 11,517 cases reported from Sept. 10 to Sept. 23, based on its latest Ulat ng Ahensya report. The department also flagged 17 provinces and highly urbanized cities across 10 regions for localized increases in ILI cases, with Metro Manila recording the most flagged areas.
